events.body:
## Context

`lib/src/util/api/leaderboard_api.dart` decodes bodies `as List` / `["results"]` without checking `statusCode`, so a 404/500 or HTML error page becomes an uncaught TypeError. `getMoreMonthlyLeaders` uses the global `http.get`, so it can't be mocked.

## What to do

1. Check `statusCode` and throw a typed exception.
2. Inject an `http.Client` into `getMoreMonthlyLeaders`.
3. Add MockClient tests for 500 and malformed JSON in `test/unit_tests/leaderboard_test.dart`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Non-200 gives a clear exception
- [ ] New tests pass
- [ ] Providers still compile

## How to test locally

```bash
cd blt-flutter && flutter test test/unit_tests/leaderboard_test.dart
```
